capabilities: Run configurable focus, short break, and long break cycles
Start a timer from a Markdown task line and update its completed/estimated interval count
Notify on interval end via system or in-app notification, screen flash, and sounds
Play tick and white-noise sounds with per-sound volume controls
Control start, pause, reset, and skip through commands and hotkeys
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in timer, and focus-session counts have to be tracked manually instead of updating task lines as intervals complete.
summary: Pomodoro-style interval timer that runs focus and break cycles from the status bar and records completed intervals on Markdown task lines.
